City Council Meeting
TORRANCE CITY COUNCIL AGENDA
JUNE 24, 2025
ADJOURNED REGULAR MEETING

in council chamber AT 3031 Torrance Bl.

Invocation - Councilmember Mattucci
3.
COUNCIL COMMITTEE MEETINGS AND ANNOUNCEMENTS
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS #1 (Limited up to a 15-minute period) This portion of the meeting is reserved for comment on items that are not on the agenda. Under the Ralph M. Brown Act, City Council cannot act on items raised during public comment but may respond briefly to statements made or questions posed; request clarification; or refer the item to staff. Speakers under Orals are limited to 1 minute. If presenting handout material to Council, please provide 11 copies to the City Clerk before speaking.
